neighbours.label: The word 'you' meaning anyone, as the subject of a tip's main clause right after a reason or condition (', so you can…', 'If…, you'll want…'); quiet for 'you' as an object or in a story about a past event, and for other subjects (we, she, one) in the same tip
neighbours.short: generic 'you' opening a tip after a reason or condition
neighbours.notes: Cold run (labelled from own tops and probes only). Broad pole (7.7% of tokens >0.1 max); tops also include existential 'there' and partitive 'of' after a quantifier, which the inverse solver found as a leak. Sentences written blind by a label-only second author.
